description:
PR A cutover is independent of live agent synchronization. Preserve IDs/history/ratings/attachments/shares/traces and authorized audit access, fail closed on ambiguous legacy audience, exclude legacy from fresh auto-hydration. Never rewrite/replay applied migrations. Private execution storage needed solely for preservation is a documented minimal A schema exception; B owns runtime writes/consumption.

## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR A. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.12; no self-approval.

Introduce associations and separate execution-private records before strategy integration. Structurally migrate legacy messages into their original transcripts while retaining IDs/references where feasible. Preserve ratings, attachments, shares, traces and audit access. Mark legacy histories explicitly and exclude them from new automatic hydration. Test atomicity, dedupe, associations, legacy authorization and rollback safeguards before migration code.

Reuse unconsumed migrations where safe; account separately for developer/test databases that already applied earlier versions. Do not blindly replay altered migrations on populated databases.

Depends on canonical schema and strategy contract. Owns cutover, not reconstruction of old audiences. Tests first: original ID/reference preservation, attachment/rating/share/trace access parity, private execution separation, concurrent cutover boundary, no legacy auto-hydration, guarded rollback, already-applied dev/test variants. Files: unconsumed migrations and migration tests, legacy-compatible Engine queries. Action reuse: extend canonical migration/persistence, no new Action. Mocking: real DB, external transport only. Documentation: Engine migration/cutover guidance.

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.12. No commit/push authorization is implied.
title: [zaq-emb.15] Legacy canonical migration and fresh-history cutover
